rationale:
Makes the capability-control registry discoverable offline and closes the hole where a typed operation could ship undocumented. `inspector_truth_check.py` gains `--write`, which generates the capability and operation matrices in docs/reference/development-inspector-capabilities.md from inspect/include/pulp/inspect/capability_definitions.inc and inspect/src/control_manifest.cpp, and its check now requires every one of the 21 typed operations to name the capability contract that gates it -- previously only the 22 capabilities were enforced, so a second operation added to an already-documented capability shipped undescribed with every gate green. `pulp control capabilities [--json]` prints that same frozen registry with no broker connection and no live instance, reusing serialize_control_registry() verbatim rather than adding a second projection.

The family is crossed by exactly one path: docs/status/cli-commands.yaml, the repo-wide CLI command manifest, which is a design-output-and-packaging selector. That edit documents the new `control capabilities` subcommand and nothing else. The other nine changed paths in this branch match no selector in this family: no importer, design-import, packaging, template, release-workflow or installed-SDK-staging code changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a documentation edit that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
tests: python3 tools/scripts/inspector_truth_check.py (capability and operation matrices in sync)
python3 tools/scripts/test_inspector_truth_check.py (26 cases; operation gate, --write round-trip, bounded registry scan)
pulp-test-cli-inspect-shellout (offline `pulp control capabilities` human and --json output)
